topics.title: Is This Internship Worth Taking?
hook_candidates: Not every internship is worth accepting.
If you are stuck on internship quality, watch this before your next application.
topics.promise: Before you accept an internship, check whether it will actually move you forward.
proof_points: The title matters less than the evidence you can build.
Good internships include feedback, ownership, and useful exposure.
If the role is vague, ask what you will actually do each week.
topics.core_takeaway: A useful internship gives real tasks, feedback, a named manager, and evidence you can show later.
